provenance: arXiv:2511.05807 ROOT data release (NOvA_NumubarCCPi0_DataRelease.root). Each of the six TDirectories (pi0p, pi0dir, muonp, muondir, Q2, Wmass) provides xsec (TH1D) plus cov_stat and cov_syst (TH2D). Bin edges/values read from xsec (histogram values carry a 10^-40 factor, converted to absolute cm^2/nucleon/unit). Per-bin error = sqrt(diag(total_cov)) with total_cov = cov_stat + cov_syst (element-wise); covariances already in absolute units. Each distribution carries its own total_cov, assembled block-diagonal (release reports no inter-observable correlations). Matrices symmetrized M=0.5*(M+M.T) against ROOT rounding.
